reasons.text: The check_duplicates tool found another claim (ef1da974-38bd-554b-b93d-2fb9f981eaad) sharing the same label photo, so the claim must be sent to a person for review under the duplicate rule.

The label photo reads clearly as model P1441, which is not on the recalled list (P1410, P1410-P, P1411, P1411-P), and the typed model P1410-P does not match the legible label; this mismatch would otherwise support denial, but the duplicate flag takes precedence.
The purchase is from a listed retailer (walmart.com) within the sale window, and no receipt or destruction photo is required, so those checks pass.
